meaning.en: (anatomy) A central carpal bone or tarsal bone.

sentences.en: As an intermedium of flux economy, convention and exhibition economy is characterized of multiplier effect, less exchange cost, stronger driving effect, and so on.

sentences.en: Mechanical background and intermedium quality engineer certified by the national certification test is a plus.
